name: doubted-heading-count

finding.title: `projects_heading` counts archived projects that the list hides
finding.description: The new heading shows `user.projects.count`. The index action in `app/controllers/projects_controller.rb` lists `user.projects.active`, so a user with 9 active and 3 archived projects sees "Projects (12)" above a list of 9 rows.

prDiff:
diff --git a/app/helpers/projects_helper.rb b/app/helpers/projects_helper.rb
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/helpers/projects_helper.rb
+++ b/app/helpers/projects_helper.rb
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 module ProjectsHelper
   def projects_heading(user)
-    "Projects"
+    "Projects (#{user.projects.count})"
   end
 end
